segments.normalizedSource: ```swift let transactions = """ CREDIT 109912311421 Payroll $69.73 CREDIT 105912031123 Travel $121.54 DEBIT 107733291022 Refund $8.42 """ let transactionLimit = 100.0 let regex = Regex { "$" TryCapture { OneOrMore(.digit) "." Repeat(.digit, count: 2) } transform: { str -> Double? in let value = Double(str)! if value > transactionLimit { return value } return nil } Anchor.endOfLine } ```
